title: Fit each gas detector at the right height for its gas: LPG low, natural gas high
instruction: fit each gas detector by the appliance that burns its gas, at the right height for that gas
context: A gas detector only works where the leaking gas collects: LPG (propane, butane) is heavier than air and pools at the floor, while natural gas (methane) is lighter and rises to the ceiling. Installers fit them low or high accordingly; each detector starts nearer the other appliance.
setup: Positions are measured on the table from the midpoint between the two arm bases: forward is away from the arms, left and right as seen from behind the arms. (1) Appliances, fixed: an LPG heater (6 x 14 x 12 cm) centred 43 cm forward and 18 cm left, and a gas boiler (6 x 12 x 14 cm) centred 43 cm forward and 18 cm right, each with a white card fixed flat by it (15.5 cm forward, 20 cm left and right) printed "LPG / HEATER" and "GAS / BOILER". (2) Ledges, fixed, in front of each appliance: a low ledge with a 7 x 7 cm top 2 cm up, centred 24 cm forward, and a tall ledge with a 7 x 7 cm top 16 cm up, centred 33 cm forward. (3) Detectors: two white blocks 5 x 5 cm and 4 cm tall, 60 g, loose, standing 12 cm forward: the LPG detector 6 cm right and the natural-gas detector 6 cm left, each with a white card fixed flat in front of it (6 cm forward) printed "LPG" and "NAT / GAS". Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Scored once, after the episode ends. A detector is on a ledge when it rests still with its centre over the ledge's top and its underside within 1 cm of it. 0.5 for the LPG detector on the heater's low ledge and 0.5 for the natural-gas detector on the boiler's tall ledge, so 1.0 for both; a detector at the wrong height or by the wrong appliance earns nothing.
reset_notes: Stand the two detectors back on their starting spots. The appliances, ledges and cards are fixed (putty) and stay in place.
fidelity: Dream Labs' YAM station replica in Isaac Lab-Arena (Isaac Sim). The detectors are plain rigid blocks set on ledges rather than screwed to a wall, and the appliances are fixed boxes; no gas is simulated. The card letters are thin black boxes on white cards.
